9f3ecd7c5be17555.job_title: AM / DM - Hydraulic- Steel melting shop (SMS)
9f3ecd7c5be17555.description: Job Purpose The Incumbent is responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, reliability and performance improvement of hydraulic systems across an EAF-based Steel Melting Shop. The role involves preventive and breakdown maintenance, hydraulic equipment inspection, shutdown planning, spare parts management and coordination with SMS operations to ensure maximum equipment availability and safe plant operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Hydraulic System Maintenance Maintain hydraulic systems associated with the Electric Arc Furnace (EAF), Ladle Furnace (LF), Continuous Casting Machine (CCM) and other SMS equipment. Handle hydraulic power packs (HPUs), pumps, hydraulic motors, cylinders, directional control valves, pressure-control valves, proportional/servo valves and accumulators. Maintain hydraulic circuits used for furnace tilting, electrode lifting, roof movement and other mechanisms, wherever hydraulically operated. Inspect hydraulic pipelines, hoses, filters, oil coolers and lubrication systems. 2. Preventive and Breakdown Maintenance Prepare and execute preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance schedules. Diagnose hydraulic failures, including pressure loss, oil leakage, overheating, abnormal noise and slow or erratic actuator movement. Carry out root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring hydraulic failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Minimize equipment downtime and improve hydraulic system reliability and availability. 3. Hydraulic Oil and Contamination Control Monitor hydraulic oil quality, filtration, cleanliness and contamination levels. Ensure proper oil sampling, filtration, flushing and replacement as per equipment requirements. Monitor operating pressure, temperature, flow rate and other critical hydraulic parameters. 4. Shutdown Planning and Execution Plan and coordinate hydraulic maintenance during scheduled shutdowns and major overhauls. Coordinate with SMS operations, electrical maintenance, instrumentation and mechanical maintenance teams. Ensure timely completion of maintenance activities with minimum production interruption. 5. Spare Parts and Documentation Identify critical hydraulic spares and maintain optimum inventory levels. Coordinate with procurement for pumps, valves, seals, hoses and other hydraulic components. Maintain equipment history, breakdown reports, maintenance records and hydraulic system documentation. 6. Team Management and Safety Supervise hydraulic technicians, fitters and maintenance contractors. Allocate jobs, monitor maintenance quality and ensure timely execution. Follow plant safety procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO), permit-to-work systems and safe isolation practices. Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures and housekeeping requirements. Desired Candidate Profile Qualification: B. Tech/Diploma-Mechanical (Full Time Regular) Experience- Post Experience 8+ Years

9fbf356c8aa70d1f.description: About Oumla Oumla is a blockchain technology company based in Riyadh. We build digital asset custody and capital markets infrastructure for banks, financial institutions and capital market entities in Saudi Arabia. We work as a technology provider: our clients' own licences carry each offering. About the Role You will own one of Oumla's core treasury and capital markets products, from discovery and product definition through to production. The product connects banks' treasury systems with market infrastructure, so that transactions settle through a shared ledger. This role sits between bank treasury desks and our engineering team. You bring the treasury view: how a transaction is priced, booked, settled and managed through its life. You turn that into product decisions, and you challenge our assumptions wherever they diverge from treasury practice. Responsibilities Product ownership Own the product roadmap, requirements and backlog, in line with company priorities set by the CEO and Head of Product. Write product requirements and user stories for each transaction flow, covering the full life cycle from execution to maturity, including margining, early termination and default handling. Define acceptance criteria with engineering and sign off on releases. Treasury and market expertise Validate product designs against real treasury, operations and settlement practice in Saudi banks. Translate Shariah-compliant structures and their documentation into product rules. Keep the team current on SAMA and CMA developments that affect treasury products and settlement. Integration and technical direction Lead the integration design between Oumla and treasury systems, the securities depository, the clearing house and payment rails. Define API requirements, event flows and data mappings with engineering, and review API documentation before it goes to partners. Coordinate testing and reconciliation with partner banks and market infrastructure. Partners and stakeholders Act as the day-to-day product contact for banks, market infrastructure and technology vendors in Riyadh. Run working sessions, prepare product materials and track actions to closure. Report progress, risks and decisions to the CEO and Head of Product. Required Qualifications At least five years in bank treasury, money markets or treasury operations, with direct exposure to fixed income and money market instruments, including sukuk. Experience in a Saudi bank is required. Working knowledge of Islamic finance structures used in treasury. At least three years in product management, product ownership or a business analyst role on financial systems, with a track record of shipping products used by institutions. Clear understanding of the trade life cycle: execution, booking, confirmation, settlement and post-trade. Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken. Based in Riyadh and able to work from the Oumla office and meet partners on site. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with treasury and trading platforms, ideally on implementation or integration projects. Technical background in software, systems integration or data, enough to read API specifications, review event and message flows, and guide engineers on implementation choices. Familiarity with market infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including the securities depository, central clearing and RTGS payments. Understanding of blockchain, tokenisation or distributed ledger concepts. Exposure to SAMA and CMA requirements for treasury products and capital markets. Relevant certifications, such as the ACI Dealing Certificate, CFA or a recognised Islamic finance qualification.

9f9d8fd615cec4e3.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs is a global company focused on solving critical problems across various sectors, including urban development, environmental resilience, and manufacturing. The company aims to transform abstract ideas into realities that benefit the world. Role Overview Jacobs is seeking a Senior MEP Engineer to join the team in Neom, Tabuk, or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing technical leadership for the completion, commissioning, and handover of a major water infrastructure project. The position focuses on leading Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) completion activities as the project enters its close-out phase, ensuring systems are installed, tested, commissioned, documented, and handed over according to project requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead MEP completion and close-out activities for water infrastructure assets and facilities. Monitor contractor progress against completion schedules and handover milestones. Coordinate the resolution of technical issues, defects, Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and punch list items. Oversee testing, commissioning, system integration, and performance verification activities. Review commissioning documentation, test records, completion dossiers, and turnover packages. Ensure all MEP installations comply with approved specifications, project requirements, and applicable industry standards. Coordinate handover activities, including as-built documentation, asset registers, Operations & Maintenance (O&M) manuals, training records, and warranty documentation. Act as the primary technical interface between contractors, consultants, operations teams, and client representatives during project close-out. Support quality inspections, operational readiness reviews, and final acceptance processes. Promote safety, technical excellence, and compliance with project procedures, regulatory requirements, and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant engineering field. Demonstrated experience in MEP systems, particularly within water infrastructure projects. Experience with construction completion, punch list closure, defect resolution, operational readiness, and handover activities. Work Location This position is based in Saudi Arabia, with opportunities in Neom, Tabuk, and Riyadh, covering all SA Regions. Application Information This is a full-time role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9fb6e5307f2e4f32.description: About GEO Global Engineering Office GEO Global Engineering Office (GEO) is a multidisciplinary firm offering professional services across the Middle East. The company integrates diverse expertise in design, engineering, planning, and consulting to address complex challenges in the built environment. GEO delivers sustainable solutions for multiple projects from its offices in the UAE and KSA, focusing on core business areas including Buildings, Roads, Infrastructure, and Urbanism. The firm aims to build teams of leading professionals whose skills align with client and staff diversity, ensuring capabilities for various project demands. The Architect Role GEO Global Engineering Office is seeking a full-time, on-site Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves developing architectural concepts and producing detailed designs, working within a multidisciplinary environment. The Architect will ensure design intent is maintained throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Develop architectural concepts and produce detailed designs and drawings. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure design intent is maintained throughout project stages. Collaborate with engineers and planners on project execution. Review technical documentation and integrate design solutions with existing infrastructure. Support project delivery from concept development through construction. Participate in client meetings and prepare presentations and reports. Ensure compliance with local regulations, sustainability goals, and GEO’s quality standards. Contribute to internal design reviews and optimize workflows for integrated project delivery. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in architecture. Demonstrated ability to develop architectural concepts and produce detailed designs. Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams. Additional Information This position is open exclusively to Saudi nationals. The work type for this role is full-time, based on-site in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9fc492f45d4de94f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خصائص التربة الزراعية، وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، وتحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الخصائص الفيزيائية والكيميائية للتربة الزراعية ومكوناتها، ومتابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم مدى استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري واختيار الأنسب منها (كالري السطحي، بالرشاشات، المحوري، أو الموضعي)، وتصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها لتحسين الأداء. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة (مثل آلات الحراثة، الزراعة، الرش، الحصاد، جرش وخلط الحبوب)، وإعداد برامج تشغيلها وصيانتها، والتأكد من جاهزيتها للعمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. القدرة على دراسة خصائص التربة وتحديد مكوناتها. مهارات في تصميم وتطوير شبكات الري والصرف الزراعي. معرفة بالآلات الزراعية المختلفة وكيفية تشغيلها وصيانتها. متطلبات إضافية القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم البيانات والنتائج. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9fd7ff71bd3e78bc.description: About the Role Nasser Al Sayer Group is seeking a Senior Executive, Legal Services to oversee and manage legal cases and execution orders involving the Group's companies. This full-time role focuses on maintaining legal compliance and effectively handling legal proceedings. Key Responsibilities Maintain the Al Sayer Legal Register by opening new debtor files and updating existing debtor information. Review credit documents prior to approval. Follow up on court proceedings with external lawyers and provide necessary information as required. Attend legal proceedings at District Courts and the Consumer Protection Agency. Analyze cases and legal issues, then assign cases to the Officer, Legal Services. Monitor and follow up on daily tasks assigned to the Officer, Legal Services. Apply penalties to debtors where the fairness of the claim has been declared by the Court. Prepare and submit monthly reports on the status of legal cases and issues to the Senior Group Manager, Legal Services. Advise legal debtors and employees on issues that may lead to legal implications. Follow up on and collect installment payments from legal debtors or those pending at the Court Cashier, providing receipts for collected amounts. Maintain the Salah Al Jassem Legal Program to record and update all legal cases. Coordinate court cases, legal proceedings, and private legal matters involving affiliate companies and Board members. Reporting and Coordination This role involves regular reporting to the Senior Group Manager, Legal Services, and close coordination with external legal counsel, internal teams, and relevant authorities. The Senior Executive will ensure all legal documentation and processes are accurately maintained and followed. Work Environment The Senior Executive, Legal Services will operate within the legal department of Nasser Al Sayer Group, handling a diverse portfolio of legal matters. This is a full-time position requiring consistent engagement with legal processes and stakeholders. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9fdc8a8c4583ef2b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مسؤولية شاملة تشمل إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. كما يشمل الدور إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية في المشاريع الصناعية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والمعالجة. المهام الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال في الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركة المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات، مما يوفر بيئة داعمة لتطوير المهارات المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. نشجع المهندسين الكهربائيين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة على التقديم.

9fde6a765c4e6c82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرم الوطن عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمسؤوليات القيادة والتشغيل الآمن للشاحنات الصغيرة، مع الالتزام بالمعايير والإجراءات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنات الثقيلة وفقاً لمسارات العمل المحددة وخطط العمل المتبعة. الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، مع الحرص على عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة لضمان جاهزيتها، ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة عند ملاحظة أي خلل يتطلب فحصاً من قبل الخبراء المختصين. الالتزام الكامل بأدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كسائق شاحنة صغيرة أو ما يعادلها. معرفة قوية بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للشاحنة وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادة ممتازة وسجل قيادة نظيف. الانتباه للتفاصيل والقدرة على الملاحظة الدقيقة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. مهارات تواصل أساسية لرفع تقارير الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل سائق الشاحنة الصغيرة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في حفر الباطن. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة والعمل ضمن فريق لدعم العمليات اللوجستية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة كرم الوطن.

9ff45b5d0627771d.description: About Vanderlande and the Role Vanderlande is a leading provider of innovative solutions for airport logistics, specializing in baggage and cargo handling, high-end software for logistics digitalization, and extensive maintenance and services. The company serves renowned airports and airlines globally. This full-time position for a Quality Engineer - Mechanical is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Contribution The Quality Engineer - Mechanical will join the Quality Management team to ensure compliance with project quality plans and quality control documentation. This role involves developing and implementing quality control processes, managing documentation, and supporting the organizational quality management system. The position is critical for maintaining quality standards across projects and operations. Key Responsibilities Guide and control suppliers, subcontractors, and in-house teams to ensure adherence to project quality plans and documentation. Develop and implement project-related documentation, including Inspection and Test Plans, Records, Method Statements, and Supplier Quality Requirements. Prepare and submit technical documentation such as Inspection Requests (IR), Material Inspection Requests (MIR), supplier/subcontractor submittals, and End-Project Documentation. Plan and prepare internal project status meeting data to align with the planned project schedule. Assist in implementing the project quality plan and organizational quality management system, including procedure development, work instructions, and forms. Manage document and record control, nonconformity control, corrective actions, internal audits, and identify improvement opportunities. Conduct supplier audits, incoming inspections, in-process inspections, installation, and commissioning inspections, documenting results (FAT & SAT). Identify and address nonconformities and implement corrective actions. Prepare and deliver regular work reports and manage work schedules to meet project deadlines. Ensure regular updates of the quality inspection status overview and Global List of Open Points (GLOP). Follow up with subcontractors and relevant departments to close open snags and non-conformities. Identify improvement opportunities and propose solutions for change, applying standard quality control tools such as histograms, control charts, and Pareto analysis. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant quality engineering role. Comprehensive knowledge of quality fundamentals and the ability to communicate them effectively. Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 is an advantage. Work Environment and Culture This role is a full-time position within Vanderlande's Quality Management team in Jeddah, Makkah. Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, committed to considering qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

9ff5d54fe9fa0aa3.description: About * Renal Care Saudi Arabia * Renal Care Saudi Arabia is a leader in the dialysis industry, committed to recognizing and celebrating the diversity within its workforce. The company focuses on recruiting top talent and fostering an inclusive work environment at all organizational levels. Role Overview The Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) role is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring 2-5 years of experience. This position is responsible for preventing and reducing Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs) among patients, visitors, and staff. The IPC Practitioner coordinates the facility's Infection Prevention and Control Program in accordance with GDIPC/MOH requirements, accreditation standards, scientific references, internal policies, and approved governance structures. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and periodically review the IPC Program, annual plan, priorities, and policies based on Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA). Ensure compliance with Ministry of Health (MOH), General Department of Infection Prevention and Control (GDIPC), Weqaya, CBAHI, applicable international standards, and approved USRC policies. Conduct infection surveillance using approved methodologies and monitor dialysis-related infection indicators and transmission risks. Analyze surveillance and audit data, identify trends, and recommend performance improvement initiatives. Maintain IPC evidence files, surveillance records, audit schedules, committee reports, corrective action plans (CAPA), and closure evidence. Report IPC performance indicators, surveillance findings, and significant risks to the IPC Committee, QAPI, leadership, and regulatory authorities, including escalation when required. Report communicable diseases and notifiable events through approved MOH reporting channels. Conduct IPC audits, environmental rounds, and infection control risk assessments. Oversee infection prevention practices, including hand hygiene, PPE use, isolation precautions, sharps safety, waste management, environmental cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, safe injection practices, and dialysis station turnover practices. Oversee environmental hygiene activities and identify infection risks within clinical and support service areas, including kitchen environments. Investigate outbreaks, exposure incidents, and significant IPC risks, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions. Oversee staff screening, immunization, occupational exposure management, and post-exposure activities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. Provide IPC orientation, education, consultation, and technical guidance to staff, patients, families, and multidisciplinary teams. Collaborate with medical, nursing, laboratory, housekeeping, biomedical, dietary, HR, and operational teams to support IPC activities and regulatory compliance. Ensure IPC responsibilities, protected time, and resources are appropriately documented and allocated in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. Perform other duties related to the Infection Prevention and Control Program as assigned. Reporting Structure Solid Line – Head Nurse: Responsible for administrative matters, including attendance, leave, scheduling, timesheets, and daily administrative coordination. Dotted Line – Clinical Services Director: Responsible for functional oversight of the IPC program, including surveillance, audits, MOH reporting, training, technical guidance, and IPC performance evaluation. Medical Director: Provides clinical governance and escalation support as required. Position Specifics This is a full-time IPC assignment. The designated IPC Practitioner will be exclusively assigned to Infection Prevention and Control activities and will not be considered part of routine nursing staffing allocation or assigned routine patient care, dialysis, staffing coverage, or other non-IPC duties. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in Infection Prevention and Control.

9f02e8f95c061abf.description: About the Role Jamjoom Pharma is seeking an Ophtha Brand Manager to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for driving growth within the KSA healthcare market by developing and executing strategic marketing plans for the ophthalmology portfolio. The Brand Manager will focus on strengthening brand positioning, maximizing market penetration, and ensuring successful commercialization of products. Role Context and Objectives The Ophtha Brand Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams, healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders (KOLs), distributors, and healthcare authorities. The primary objective is to deliver impactful marketing initiatives, support successful product launches, and contribute to sustainable business growth for Jamjoom Pharma's ophthalmology products. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute annual brand plans aligned with business strategy and commercial objectives. Analyze market research, business performance, customer insights, and competitive landscape to identify opportunities and challenges. Track and analyze brand and competitor performance, market dynamics, and key growth drivers to recommend actions for maximizing brand performance. Utilize market analytics and business intelligence to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. Support the implementation of marketing initiatives and new product launches, monitoring performance against KPIs. Develop sales forecasts and financial assumptions for business planning and new business case evaluations. Monitor promotional budgets, report utilization, and assess ROI to the Marketing Manager. Develop promotional campaigns, sales tools, scientific materials, and customer engagement programs. Drive digital marketing initiatives, CRM programs, and omnichannel customer engagement. Collaborate with Sales, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance teams. Identify and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare professionals, and key accounts. Support Medical Affairs in identifying local advocates and emerging speakers. Deliver product training and provide market, competitor, and product updates to the sales force. Ensure all marketing activities comply with KSA healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and ethical promotional practices. Anticipate market changes, identify business opportunities, and propose mitigation and growth strategies. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. At least 2 years of experience at Jamjoom Pharma. A performance rating of “Meets Expectations” or higher in each of the past two years. At least 2 years of marketing experience or relevant ophthalmology experience, demonstrating a strong understanding of the ophthalmology business and market. 9fc348786e613181.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب وتشغيل الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لضمان كفاءة عملها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب، والإشراف على إجراءات التركيب، وإعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي والتشغيل الفعلي للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية، وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بما يتوافق مع تعليمات الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل الدورية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية للأجهزة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الطبية ضمن فريق متخصص في المدينة المنورة، ويكون مسؤولاً عن دعم العمليات التشغيلية والصيانة للأجهزة الطبية الحيوية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: المدينة المنورة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور.

9fefb576257a2db5.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor for a contract position in Jeddah. This role is responsible for executing IsDB’s Operations audit plans to ensure that operational results align with Management’s plans and comply with relevant policies, procedures, and legal agreements. The Senior Internal Auditor will also identify potential risks, evaluate existing control tools, and propose new ones to prevent or mitigate risk impact on business results. Key Responsibilities Participate in the preparation of the yearly Operations Audit plan and collaborate with the audit team to plan and develop operations-related audit activities. Lead or participate in the execution of the audit plan, reviewing management processes and internal controls to assess their adequacy and effectiveness. Ensure compliance with relevant policies, internal controls, procedures, standards, best practices, and applicable Management plans/decisions, covering IsDB operations project’s cycle, disbursement including programming, preparation, appraisal, supervision, and impact evaluation. Ascertain whether controls operate effectively to ensure accountability for decision-making and implementation of decisions. Examine and evaluate processes and internal controls in IsDB’s Operations units in the headquarters to ensure operational results are consistent with Management’s relevant plans and comply with relevant policies, procedures, and legal agreements. Review and assess the effectiveness of operational activities in Regional Hubs in areas such as procurement, disbursement, and supervision. Determine whether appropriate risk management processes are in place, adequate, and effective, and recommend improvements. Provide recommendations to IsDB Management based on internal audit findings and discuss the impact of risk-related areas. Ensure the preparation of a concise and informative audit report to effectively communicate findings and recommendations to relevant functions and senior management. Liaise with the IT Audit unit to collaboratively audit auditee functions using data analytics, IT automated systems, and controls. Develop and maintain effective and professional working relationships with all levels of staff, including Senior Management and the Audit Committee of the Board. Conduct investigations of suspected internal fraud, where necessary. Assist in any special audit assignments or investigations mandated by management. Operational Excellence Ensure effective implementation and adherence to policies, procedures, and controls to fulfill all relevant procedural/professional requirements. Keep abreast of the latest developments, regulations, and leading practices in the field and propose any necessary actions. Propose and implement process improvements to increase the efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance of related business processes. Experience Required Candidates should possess 8-10 years of relevant experience in internal audit, particularly within operations. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Jeddah.

9fffd0fb3d06bf35.description: About the Role Accenture Saudi Arabia is seeking a Security Delivery Manager to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on strengthening clients' cyber defense capabilities by leading the delivery of SIEM logging and security monitoring enablement within complex enterprise environments. The manager will combine strong technical knowledge of SIEM and log management with delivery leadership to ensure security-relevant data is onboarded, normalized, and validated for effective threat detection and monitoring. Key Responsibilities The Security Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading SIEM and logging delivery, providing technical and delivery leadership, and managing service governance. Lead end-to-end delivery of log-source assessment, onboarding, and validation into enterprise SIEM platforms, with a preference for Splunk. Define and govern logging requirements aligned with security monitoring, detection, and investigation use cases. Oversee log onboarding activities including source identification, ingestion, parsing, field extraction, normalization, and validation. Assess log sources for quality, completeness, consistency, and security value, identifying gaps and recommending remediation. Ensure required security events and fields are accurately captured and made available to monitoring and detection teams. Technical and Delivery Leadership Provide technical direction and troubleshooting support for complex log ingestion, parsing, mapping, and data-quality issues. Apply knowledge of common logging formats and protocols, including syslog, JSON, Windows Event Logs, and application logs. Drive consistent approaches to data normalization and standardization across diverse technology environments. Understand how telemetry supports detection engineering and collaborate with detection teams to ensure logs meet defined use-case requirements. Coordinate dependencies across application, infrastructure, platform, and cybersecurity teams to enable required logging. Lead delivery through batch-based, wave-based, or phased onboarding approaches, balancing delivery priorities, dependencies, and technical readiness. Service Management and Governance Own delivery planning, progress tracking, risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder reporting for assigned logging initiatives. Establish clear quality criteria and ensure onboarding outputs meet agreed technical and operational requirements. Produce high-quality assessments, onboarding documentation, status reporting, and management-level updates. Facilitate working sessions with technical teams and stakeholders to resolve blockers and maintain delivery momentum. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes, logging standards, operational efficiency, and monitoring coverage. Act as a trusted point of coordination between cybersecurity teams and technology stakeholders. Work Environment This role involves working closely with security, application, infrastructure, and engineering teams to translate detection and monitoring requirements into actionable logging requirements. The position is based in Riyadh and is a full-time engagement.

9f07c6a57c3f76e8.description: About the Role The American International School Riyadh is seeking a licensed, full-time Elementary EAL (English as an Additional Language) Teacher for the 2026-2027 school year. This part-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports to the Elementary School Principal. The start date for this role is November 1, 2026. Candidates must meet the minimum criteria outlined to be considered. Purpose of the AIS-R Teacher The primary purpose of an AIS-R teacher is to facilitate learning, critical thinking, and caring among students. This involves cultivating inquisitive, independent, and resilient learners who are prepared to inspire positive change within their communities. Key Responsibilities and Expectations Design and deliver lessons, content, and materials aligned with AIS-R’s standard curriculums and teaching standards, utilizing various learning mediums. Demonstrate knowledge of student strengths, interests, motivations, and abilities to plan coherent instruction that supports learning and well-being. Maintain effective classroom control, organization, and management, including managing student behavior and monitoring progress. Create a respectful, student-centered environment conducive to developmentally appropriate learning. Plan and prepare coherent learning plans with clearly defined outcomes aligned with subject-level standards and benchmarks using the Understanding by Design framework. Gather, analyze, and utilize relevant data to measure and facilitate student academic progress, communicating learning targets and assessment criteria clearly. Prioritize instructional strategies aligned with AIS-R’s Learning Principles and assess student learning with clear criteria. Collaborate with colleagues, parents, and community members to advance the school's mission and enhance student learning. Organize, plan, and run clubs/after-school activities as part of AIS-R’s co-curricular program. Engage in the school’s professional development program and professional growth & evaluation process. Partner with families through ongoing communication, conferences, and accurate reporting of student progress, honoring divisional reporting timelines. Understand and implement student safeguarding practices, including mandatory reporting and participation in inquiries regarding community members. Adhere to AIS-R policies, expectations, the Faculty/Staff Handbook, Code of Conduct, professional dress code, and Child Safeguarding agreements. Teacher Qualities and Mindset An AIS-R teacher is a continuous learner, committed to the AIS-R Mission and Core Values, and embodies the Profile of an Exemplary Educator. This role requires a qualified and dedicated global citizen with a genuine passion for teaching and learning. Essential qualities include respect, open-mindedness, adaptability, resilience, and a commitment to lifelong learning and continual professional development. Teachers are expected to make a difference beyond the school day and support the school in creating a positive, nurturing, and engaging environment that addresses individual student needs. Instructional Philosophy AIS-R teachers promote collaboration, provide sincere teacher-student relationships that value diverse cultures and beliefs, and create a safe environment where students feel supported and challenged. They connect learning to real-life explorations, provide clear learning goals and quality exemplars, and offer opportunities for questioning, analysis, application, and skill transfer. Teachers assess readiness and differentiate instruction to meet individual needs, scaffold learning, and provide opportunities for students to make decisions and have a voice in their learning. They offer varied, engaging learning opportunities and provide specific, timely feedback to support student growth and self-reflection. Professional Growth and Evaluation Performance in this role will be evaluated in accordance with school policy by the designated Supervisor.

9f152b6e10ca91b8.description: About Red Sea Global and Corallium Red Sea Global (RSG) is developing Corallium, a flagship attraction at Amaala’s Triple Bay in Saudi Arabia. Corallium aims to provide visitor experiences focused on marine education, environmental regeneration, and immersive storytelling, with the goal of becoming a global benchmark in ocean experience and stewardship. This initiative aligns with RSG’s vision for responsible tourism, sustainability, and regeneration. The Role of Retail Specialist The Retail Specialist is responsible for delivering a high standard of retail service by assisting guests and processing transactions. This full-time role involves providing product recommendations, supporting cross-promotion of attraction activities, and contributing to overall guest satisfaction and revenue generation. The position requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Welcome and greet guests professionally, in line with the attraction's service standards. Assist guests with product inquiries and provide accurate information to support purchasing decisions. Process sales transactions accurately using the point-of-sale (POS) system, including various payment methods. Actively cross-sell and upsell retail products to maximize sales opportunities. Promote and cross-sell the attraction's wider activities and experiences. Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing retail space, ensuring products are displayed correctly and shelves are stocked. Monitor and replenish stock levels, reporting low inventory to the supervisor. Handle guest complaints professionally, escalating issues to the supervisor when necessary. Process returns, exchanges, and refunds according to company policy. Adhere to all cash handling procedures and ensure till accuracy at the beginning and end of each shift. Participate in stock counts, audits, and inventory checks as required. Comply with all health, safety, and operational policies and procedures. Work Environment and Context This role operates within a fast-paced retail environment that involves direct customer interaction. The Specialist will support daily store operations, sales targets, and customer satisfaction initiatives. Flexibility in scheduling is required, including working weekends, public holidays, and during peak retail periods. Collaboration with store management, sales associates, and support functions is essential to achieve business objectives. Financial Responsibilities The Retail Specialist is responsible for contributing to individual and store sales targets. The role supports inventory control and stock accuracy to minimize losses and shrinkage, and contributes to revenue growth through effective product promotion and upselling. Compliance with company policies regarding cash handling and financial transactions is mandatory. Application Join the team at Corallium to contribute to a legacy of ocean stewardship and help bring the wonders of the Red Sea to life.

9f23902cc60a85db.description: About the Tamheer Training Opportunity Lantern Systems Co. Ltd is offering a Tamheer training opportunity for a Purchase Specialist. This 6-month internship is open exclusively to Saudi candidates in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. The program is designed to provide practical experience in procurement activities within a professional environment. This includes assisting with material requirement assessments, conducting market research for competitive pricing, and evaluating supplier and service provider quotations. Key Training Responsibilities Assess material needs and requirements of different organizational units and support the prioritization of purchasing needs. 9f37a021c3f40f6e.description: The Senior Manager – Project Management is responsible for leading the planning, governance, execution, and monitoring of strategic projects and initiatives across the Marketing division. The role ensures that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives while maintaining effective governance, stakeholder engagement, resource management, and performance reporting. Working closely with Marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, the role will drive project delivery excellence, manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and support the successful execution of key corporate marketing, destination marketing, brand, research, loyalty, digital, and transformation initiatives. Key Responsibilities Project Planning & Delivery Lead the end-to-end management of strategic marketing projects from initiation through execution and closure. Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, resource plans, and delivery roadmaps. Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, governance structures, and success criteria. Ensure effective coordination and execution of projects across multiple Marketing functions. Monitor project progress and drive corrective actions to maintain delivery commitments. Project Governance & Controls Establish and maintain project governance frameworks, methodologies, and reporting standards. Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and action plans. Ensure adherence to approved project management practices and governance requirements. Facilitate project steering committees, governance meetings, and executive reviews. Maintain project documentation, decision logs, and governance records. Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate activities across Marketing, Finance, Procurement, HR, Technology, Operations, and agency partners. Manage stakeholder communication and ensure alignment on project objectives and priorities. Provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership. Performance Monitoring & Reporting Develop project dashboards, status reports, and executive updates. Track project KPIs, budgets, schedules, risks, and resource utilization. Provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and issue resolution. Escalate risks, delays, and constraints proactively with proposed mitigation plans. Prepare executive presentations and performance summaries for leadership reviews. Budget & Resource Management Support project budget planning, forecasting, and tracking activities. Monitor resource allocation and utilization across projects. Ensure projects are delivered efficiently and in line with approved budgets. Support vendor management and project-related procurement activities when required. Change Management & Continuous Improvement Support organizational and operational change initiatives associated with project delivery. Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, tools, and governance practices. Promote best practices in project management and delivery excellence. Contribute to capability-building initiatives across the Strategic Planning & Delivery function. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Management, Marketing, Finance, or a related discipline. Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred. Certifications PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is mandatory. Additional certifications such as PRINCE2, PgMP, PMI-ACP, PMO-CP, Agile, or Lean Six Sigma are preferred. Experience 7+ years of experience in project management, PMO, program management, project controls, or related disciplines. Experience managing large-scale, cross-functional projects within complex organizations. Demonstrated experience leading multiple projects simultaneously and managing competing priorities. Experience working with executive stakeholders and supporting governance forums. Proven experience in project planning, risk management, budget management, performance reporting, and stakeholder engagement. Experience within large transformation programs, PIF portfolio companies, government entities, giga-projects, or multinational organizations is highly desirable.

9f747ab9ad3830fe.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Groups Coordinator to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves securing and coordinating group event bookings, contributing to memorable guest experiences. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Prospect, qualify, and convert new business opportunities through outbound efforts, proposal writing, and tailored sales strategies. Conduct site inspections and hotel tours, highlighting key spaces and services that align with client needs. Negotiate pricing, terms, and agreements with clients and vendors. Input and update event details in booking systems, coordinate site visits, and arrange VIP services. Create and distribute Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), group resumes, menus, diagrams, and post-event reports to ensure alignment across teams. Prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and maintain accurate records to support high-quality service and operational efficiency. Partner with Operations, Catering, and Revenue teams to ensure a seamless transition from sales to service. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated passion for hospitality. Ability to act with integrity and uphold ethical standards. Leadership qualities that inspire others. A collaborative approach to teamwork. A sense of ownership and accountability for responsibilities. Focus on immediate tasks with urgency and discipline. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its workplace culture. The company focuses on delivering exceptional guest experiences and fostering a supportive environment for its team members. Hilton has been acknowledged on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune.

9fb351bb2195e928.description: About Panasonic Avionics Corporation Panasonic Avionics Corporation is a leading provider of inflight entertainment and connectivity products, including movies, games, WiFi, and Bluetooth headphone connectivity. With over 40 years in the industry, the company offers stability and career growth opportunities within a diverse and inclusive culture. Role Overview: Customer Support Field Engineer IV The Customer Support Field Engineer IV serves as an on-site support liaison between Panasonic and airline customers in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring customer satisfaction and optimal performance of Panasonic equipment. The engineer provides service, technical guidance, support, and training to airline customers to meet product performance and reliability objectives. This position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves representing Panasonic Field Engineering interests in resolving technical issues with other Panasonic and customer engineering departments, as well as providing complex technical guidance to junior engineers and managing large projects. Key Responsibilities Provide advanced technical guidance and field assistance to Panasonic personnel and airline customers for troubleshooting and resolving system hardware, network, and software issues. Perform complex troubleshooting and problem-solving for new equipment installations, enhancements, or modifications, working with engineering departments to ensure timely corrective action. Review mechanical, electrical, and software installation documentation to verify specifications are met. Collaborate with the training department to conduct operational, line, and maintenance training for airline customers. Assist in aircraft delivery and provide support during flight tests and customer flight acceptance. Participate in resolving system operation, maintenance, or reliability issues by conducting investigations and collecting data. Provide field inputs to other Panasonic departments regarding technical product issues, installation, or documentation problems. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of Panasonic products and installations, including system software and associated equipment. Provide regular, accurate, and detailed technical reports to Field Engineering management and relevant departments. Manage relationships between Panasonic and assigned customers to ensure satisfaction and long-term business relationships. Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced team members. Required Qualifications and Skills Ability to assist with technical issues impacting multiple airline programs. Advanced working knowledge of aircraft systems that interface with Panasonic Avionics Corp equipment. Advanced understanding and utilization of wiring schematics, diagrams, and other engineering/aircraft documentation. Extensive knowledge of multiple Panasonic Avionics Corp product lines and/or system types. Proficiency in identifying and communicating complex engineering problems in software and hardware to Field Engineering Management. Advanced engineering-level product knowledge in avionics and related software areas. Proficient using MS Office suite of products. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Effective interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Advanced ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize responsibilities with minimum supervision. Demonstrated ability to lead teams and perform as a technical expert. Highly proficient in project planning, addressing external/internal dependencies across multiple functions. Proven ability to extensively modify existing processes, procedures, or methods to develop appropriate solutions. Demonstrable experience providing identifiable technical contributions to the success of a product or project. Proven ability to develop technical approaches, resource allocation, or time schedules for projects. Ability to effectively interact with senior internal and external personnel. Additional Requirements Must hold a valid driver’s license and meet airport authority requirements for access and vehicle operation. Ability to travel up to 50%, both domestic and international, often on short notice. Ability and willingness to provide weekend and after-hours support as required. Able to obtain Airport Security access, which may require passing a Criminal Records check and Drugs/Alcohol test.

9fbe937030b2957c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في حقل، تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، وتحديد قطع الغيار، وتشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة عمليات تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها الأولية. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية لأغراض الصيانة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص الأعطال الفنية في المحركات الميكانيكية ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات. معرفة قوية بتركيب المحركات الميكانيكية وتشغيلها. القدرة على تحديد قطع الغيار ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. مهارات ممتازة في فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات في منطقة حقل بتبوك. يتطلب العمل الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9ff85a7ec46d4ef3.description: About the Role SAB is seeking a Project Finance Officer to join the Corporate & Institutional Banking - Credit and Lending department in Riyadh. 9f335c8f4a7db63f.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Projects Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This is a full-time position for professionals with 5-10 years of experience. Role Overview The Projects Manager will be responsible for overseeing project delivery activities, ensuring construction readiness, and monitoring site progress, quality, and compliance. The role involves managing contractor and consultant performance, coordinating interfaces, testing, and handover processes, and maintaining accurate project records and reporting. Core Responsibilities Manage project delivery activities across assigned assets, projects, packages, or site areas within the Business Unit. Review construction readiness inputs, including design information, procurement status, permits, logistics plans, technical submissions, and site access requirements. Monitor site progress, construction sequencing, critical path activities, workforce deployment, and delivery constraints. Ensure construction activities comply with approved specifications, Qiddiya standards, regulatory requirements, and project controls. Monitor contractor, subcontractor, construction supervision consultant, project management consultant, and delivery partner performance. 9f597f9454d866c5.job_title: CNC Coolant Filling Technician - PWHT Plants Experience
9f597f9454d866c5.description: Eram Talent is seeking a detail-oriented and highly skilled CNC Coolant Filling Technician with specific experience in Post Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) plant environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for the comprehensive management, preparation, and maintenance of metalworking fluids and coolants for high-precision CNC machinery. This role is critical to maximizing tool life, ensuring machining quality, and maintaining safe, continuous operations within a heavy industrial setting. Key Responsibilities Coolant Management: Accurately mix, distribute, and replenish coolants, cutting fluids, and lubricants across multiple CNC machines according to specific operational parameters. System Testing & Monitoring: Perform daily chemical tests using refractometers and pH meters to monitor coolant concentration, alkalinity, and biological control. Equipment Maintenance: Execute routine cleaning of machine sumps, operate tramp oil skimmers, and maintain coolant recycling and filtration equipment to prevent fluid degradation. PWHT Plant Integration: Safely navigate and operate within heavy industrial environments, specifically alongside Post Weld Heat Treatment (PWHT) operations, ensuring all fluid management aligns with the plant's production and heat-treating schedules. Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve fluid-related issues such as foaming, foul odors, rust, or poor tool life, adjusting chemical dosing as necessary. Inventory Control: Track the consumption of chemical inventory, manage stock levels of raw coolant fluids, and initiate purchase requests to prevent shortages. HSE Compliance: Strictly adhere to all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) protocols regarding the handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous chemicals and waste fluids. Maintain accurate logs and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS). Education: High School Diploma, Technical Diploma, or equivalent certification in mechanical maintenance, machining, or industrial chemistry. Core Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in CNC machine maintenance, specifically focused on fluid and coolant management. Industry Experience (Mandatory): Proven work history within heavy manufacturing, Oil & Gas, or large-scale industrial plants. Specific experience working in or around PWHT (Post Weld Heat Treatment) plants is strictly required. Technical Skills: * Proficiency in using fluid testing equipment (e.g., refractometers, titration kits). Strong understanding of coolant chemistry, mixing ratios, and bacterial control. Familiarity with CNC sump cleaning operations and industrial pumping equipment. HSE Knowledge: Solid understanding of industrial safety standards (e.g., OSHA, local regulations) and safe chemical handling/disposal procedures. Soft Skills: Excellent physical stamina, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively both independently and alongside machining operators.
